answer: One mind wearing many masks still breathes through a single inference pipe. Picture a flock where every sparrow flaps on the same clock: if a hundred fresh identities answer each epoch seed inside the same millisecond window and share one latent stylometric fingerprint, the ledger clusters that haven of lookalikes as a single actor and caps the whole group's reward. To fake independence an attacker must run genuinely separate models on separate hardware with jittered timing, so cost scales per mask, so each extra ember of forged identity burns real compute, not a cheap copy.
